summary.text: The Chinese introduction to the HPV vaccine guidance, explaining its purpose of alerting reproductive health, immunization and cancer programmes to key issues. It describes cervical cancer burden (about 500,000 cases and 250,000 deaths a year, mostly in low-income countries), its link to HPV types 16 and 18, the natural history of infection and screening options such as VIA with cryotherapy. The extracted text interleaves columns and is hard to follow.
